notes.title: Deathbloom: Chapter 2 (Large Update)
notes.content:
A large update has just been uploaded that revisits [i]Deathbloom: Chapter 2[/i] and cleans up a lot of things!

[list]
[*] [b]Optimization[/b]: FPS increase of 20%-30% on multiple scenes
[*] [b]Optimization[/b]: Fixed issue with debug log causing lag
[*] [b]Update[/b]: Boss battle now has a health bar and title
[*] [b]Update[/b]: 'New Area' UI is now larger and easier to read
[*] [b]Settings[/b]: Invert Mouse is now an option
[*] [b]Misc[/b]: Host of bug fixes throughout
[/list]

Thanks to those still playing and for those just finding the [i]Deathbloom[/i] series.

V
@VincentLade

notes.title: Special Sale on Deathbloom: Chapter 2
notes.content:
Continue your journey through Bachman Manor as you inch closer to freedom, or towards your mysterious friend Christina and her candle-lit secrets. Going deeper into the estate reveals more locations like the Abandoned Wing, Lower House, and the bunker complex "Salvation". 

[previewyoutube=M2rR5BH48cY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Classic Survival Horror[/h2]

[list]
[*] Continue your journey through Bachman Manor and find the conclusion to the horrors within.
[*] Arm yourself with 10 different weapons, each hidden throughout the dark rooms and dusty corridors.
[*] New and original enemies stalk the Manor seeking to drag you into its pits.
[*] Search for supplies, secrets areas, and letters to increase your chances of survival.
[*] Find your mysterious friend “Christina” while she helps you with her candles.
[*] Avoid the mists of “Deathbloom” or be pulled into a hallucinatory state between life and death.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36251697/525176897fa9e827b14081a3927df6c3f624ea9f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36251697/a796b47351c74e9da5f86093003db4fee355fe3b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36251697/cda7539cb0c8cc2cf0562d826d4e7dfe65eef24a.jpg[/img]

[h2]More of the Manor[/h2]

Explore new regions of the Manor, more dark and dangerous than ever before. Filled with puzzles, traps, and hidden passageways that keep the player exploring and solving its secrets.

[h2]More Guests[/h2]

You are not alone, the occupants and even manifestations of Bachman Manor itself keep the player running, hiding, or fighting for their life.

notes.title: 2.5 Month Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36251697/2f57c65fd136c542207427995fc7de51de6b9fd7.jpg[/img]

Thanks to everyone continuing their journey through Bachman Manor and the Deathbloom series!

Now that the dust has settled after launch its been fun to watch the [i]Let's Plays[/i] and see the screenshots people have submitted. 

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/790883698953880437/CB5BBC35FD56ECEEC552EF1BD9912ECC78F99CC1/[/img]

While the work on the Deathbloom series has wrapped up there are new projects on the way. Similar works of psychological horror that explore new stories, characters, and environments. One of these currently in development is my new game "The Swine" which is already deep in development and will be coming in the next month or two.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1320950

If you want to stay in the loop on what I'm working on and future Sale and Events feel free to follow me at [url=https://twitter.com/VincentLade]@VincentLade[/url] on Twitter.

And as always if you find any bugs or room for improvement you can reach me at deathbloomgame@gmail.com

-VL

notes.title: Launching soon!
notes.content:
[h2]A launch date is set![/h2]

After a long period of development [i]Deathbloom: Chapter 2[/i] is launching on [b]March 3rd at 12:00PST[/b]

I spent a bit more time than expected to add the features I wanted, but it was all worth the time investment. Some features in Chapter 2 will include:
[list][*]     Unique and cryptic puzzles (requiring more thinking than just finding items)
[*]     More weapons, including some heavy firepower
[*]     Intricate and detailed levels (including environments like the feared "Salvation" a fully sustained underground bunker)
[*]     More rewards for those that explore
[*]     Reworked the story with two endings that I think players will enjoy
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1185470/ss_e7e229504079ee62b3c3b297427c5cc706890e41.1920x1080.jpg?t=1582203864[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1185470/ss_cf70a0c03f9b7df6e843d95a9f9c9a85e57e060f.1920x1080.jpg?t=1582203864[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1185470/ss_b613a4b9dc48f0297c6b20512f4e16dea2fc6268.1920x1080.jpg?t=1582203864[/img]

So if you're in the mood for some Classic Survival Horror and wanting to see how the [i]Deathbloom[/i] story wraps-up you can grab it soon

Thanks for reading,

VL
